name: Wieliczka and Bochnia Royal Salt Mines
description: Beneath two towns near Kraków in southern Poland, the Wieliczka and Bochnia mines have been digging out rock salt since the 13th century, making them Europe's oldest operation of their kind. Hundreds of kilometres of tunnels wind underground, where visitors can walk through chapels and statues carved from salt. The medieval Saltworks Castle at Wieliczka once managed the whole enterprise.
